text: Architecture Artifact Generator always checks the readiness gate (all 5 required artifacts present) after syncing agent_workspace before writing any output files; if any artifact is missing it replies [PASS] and stops immediately

Architecture Artifact Generator re-runs all four docs/architecture/ documents on every invocation after the readiness gate passes, overwriting the prior run — the commit captures the delta; downstream agents should read the artifacts, not the prior commit

When a previously open-end seam (bus.subscribe unresolved) becomes a confirmed resolved cross-service link in a later run, the Architecture Artifact Generator upgrades chain-002 severity (high→critical) and updates the Cross-Component Security Seams table in security-posture.md to reflect the confirmed crossComponent:true hop
